event.text: Listeria in chilled ready-to-eat food is Class I, and product is likely on shelves, so I'm proposing consumer depth.

input.rationale: Listeria monocytogenes in a chilled ready-to-eat soup/sauce ingredient carries a reasonable probability of serious illness or death, and affected product may already be on store shelves and in consumers' homes.

call.name: propose_classification

input.rationale: Listeria monocytogenes in a chilled ready-to-eat soup/sauce ingredient carries a reasonable probability of serious illness or death, and affected product may already be on store shelves and in consumers' homes.

call.summary: Proposed Class I, consumer-level recall. Awaiting confirmation
cypher:
MERGE (i:Incident {lot: $lot})
ON CREATE SET i.id = $id, i.reported_at = $at, i.hazard = 'not recorded'
SET i.class = $class, i.depth = $depth, i.rationale = $rationale, i.classified_at = $at
RETURN i.id AS id, i.hazard AS hazard

event.text: Placing a hold so nothing else leaves.

call.name: place_hold
call.summary: 2,652 units and 93 kg of raw L-204 held at 5 locations
cypher:
MATCH (l:Lot {code: $lot})-[s:STORED_AT]->(site:Site)
RETURN site.id AS id, site.name AS name, site.city AS city, site.region AS region, s.qty_kg AS qty_kg, l.received_kg AS received_kg

MATCH (:Lot {code: $lot})-[:USED_IN|REWORKED_INTO|PRODUCED*1..6]->(pl:ProductLot)-[h:HELD_AT]->(loc)
WITH DISTINCT pl, h, loc
MATCH (pl)-[:OF]->(p:Product)
RETURN pl.id AS product_lot, p.name AS product, labels(loc)[0] AS kind, loc.id AS id, loc.name AS name,
       loc.city AS city, loc.region AS region, h.units AS units
ORDER BY kind, id, product_lot

MATCH (:Lot {code: $lot})-[:USED_IN|REWORKED_INTO|PRODUCED*1..6]->(:ProductLot)-[h:HELD_AT]->()
SET h.held_for = $lot, h.held_at = $at

event.text: Next I'm tracing forward to find every store that got product made with the lot, and checking for coverage gaps.

call.name: trace_forward
cypher:
MATCH path = (l:Lot {code: $lot})-[:USED_IN|REWORKED_INTO|PRODUCED|SHIPPED_TO*1..8]->(st:Store)
RETURN st.id AS store,
       [n IN nodes(path) | coalesce(n.code, n.id)] AS path,
       [n IN nodes(path) | labels(n)[0]] AS kinds,
       last(relationships(path)).units AS units

call.name: coverage_gaps
call.summary: 2 stores got Garden Vegetable Stew with no lot code on the delivery record
cypher:
MATCH (:Lot {code: $lot})-[:USED_IN|REWORKED_INTO|PRODUCED*1..6]->(pl:ProductLot)
WITH collect(DISTINCT pl.sku) AS skus
MATCH (p:Product)-[u:SHIPPED_UNTRACKED]->(st:Store)
WHERE p.sku IN skus
RETURN st.id AS store, p.sku AS sku, p.name AS product, u.units AS units, u.shipped_at AS shipped_at

event.text: Following policy, I'm building the targeted recall with the gap stores added.

cypher:

RETURN st.id AS store,
       [n IN nodes(path) | coalesce(n.code, n.id)] AS path,
       [n IN nodes(path) | labels(n)[0]] AS kinds,
       last(relationships(path)).units AS units

MATCH (:Lot {code: $lot})-[:USED_IN|REWORKED_INTO|PRODUCED*1..6]->(pl:ProductLot)
WITH collect(DISTINCT pl.sku) AS skus
MATCH (p:Product)-[u:SHIPPED_UNTRACKED]->(st:Store)
WHERE p.sku IN skus
RETURN st.id AS store, p.sku AS sku, p.name AS product, u.units AS units, u.shipped_at AS shipped_at

MATCH (:Lot {code: $lot})-[:USED_IN|REWORKED_INTO|PRODUCED*1..6]->(pl:ProductLot)
WITH collect(DISTINCT pl.sku) AS skus
MATCH (pl2:ProductLot)-[:SHIPPED_TO]->(st:Store)
WHERE pl2.sku IN skus
RETURN st.id AS store, collect(DISTINCT pl2.id) AS received_lots

event.text: Now I'm checking on my own that none of the lots received by the cleared stores contain L-204.

call.name: trace_backward
call.summary: 8 product lots walked back; 0 contain L-204
cypher:
MATCH (l:Lot)-[:USED_IN]->(:Batch)-[:REWORKED_INTO*0..3]->(:Batch)-[:PRODUCED]->(pl:ProductLot)
WHERE pl.id IN $product_lots
RETURN pl.id AS product_lot, collect(DISTINCT l.code) AS ingredient_lots

result.summary: I've proposed a Class I, consumer-level recall, because lot L-204 diced carrot tested positive for Listeria monocytogenes and it went into chilled ready-to-eat soups and sauces. A hold is in place at 5 locations covering 93 kg of unused carrot at Northfield Plant 2 and 2,652 unshipped units at Plants 1 and 2 and the Columbus, Pittsburgh and Detroit DCs. The lot went into batches B-03, B-05 and B-07 and, because leftovers of B-03 were reused, into B-09 as well, producing seven product lots (TLC-03A/B, 05A/B, 07A/B, 09A) that reached 31 stores. I also added ST-013 and ST-021 to the recall: they received Garden Vegetable Stew (25 and 24 units) with no lot code recorded, so they can't be proven safe. As a separate check, I traced all eight lots received by the 38 cleared stores (TLC-04A/B, 06A/B, 08A/B, 10A/B) back to their ingredients, and none contain L-204. Instead of a blanket recall of 71 stores, this targets 33 stores and 2,256 units and clears 38 stores; 33 draft notices are saved as pending approval, and the class, the hold release and sending the notices all wait for the recall coordinator.
